- CAKE STAND LOVEBIRD 2 TIER PINK recorded the largest gain at +1,441.2% WoW, worth £1,154.10 TW versus LW.
- WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER showed the largest decline at -30.9% WoW, or -£1,362.88 TW versus LW.
- WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER led volume TW with 1,118 units and 69 orders.
- REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER units rose 34.2% WoW and orders rose 50.0% WoW; EDWARDIAN PARASOL BLACK was the smallest listed product at £1,065.69 TW.
